sample.family:
Allow: science, animals, dinosaurs, drawing, math, other clearly educational content.
Ask me first: gaming, unboxing, and prank videos. These categories must be ask_parent by default; do not block them solely because they are gaming or pranks.
Block gaming or prank videos only when the available evidence also shows violence, weapons, scary or horror content, profanity, or adult themes.
Never allow: violence, weapons, scary or horror content, profanity, adult themes.

strict_family.family:
Block any MrBeast channel, any Minecraft-related channel, and all gaming videos where someone plays and talks over a game.
Allow educational science and animals.
Ask parent for unboxing and prank videos unless they also show violence or scary content.
Never allow violence, weapons, or horror.
strict_family.child:
Allow educational science, animals, drawing, and nature.
Ask_parent for unboxing.
Never allow scary or violent content.

lenient.family:
Allow educational gaming and playful channels if they are not scary or violent.
Ask_parent for unboxing if the title suggests the video is a challenge or prank.
No blanket gaming block.
lenient.child:
Allow science, animals, drawing, and general creativity.
Do not ask for harmless gaming or challenge content unless it becomes scary or violent.
